models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign, light-air pattern over the Aeolians now - but the 4 Oct start is nine days out and well beyond any model horizon.
briefing.synopsis: The consensus across ECMWF IFS 0.25, ECMWF AIFS and ICON-2i (all 24 Sep 00Z) shows a slack, low-gradient pattern over the islands: winds mostly 1-4 kt through 24 Sep, veering through S/W on 25 Sep, then settling into a NE-to-N flow of 7-10 kt on 26 Sep. Seas are negligible throughout - MFWAM (23 Sep 12Z) and ECMWF WAM (24 Sep 00Z) give total wave heights of 0.3-1.4 ft, peaking at 1.7 ft off Filicudi on the evening of 26 Sep. If that pattern held it would mean motoring more than sailing, with comfortable sea states everywhere. Model data runs out at 30 Sep, so nothing here says anything about the trip dates.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: No forecast is available for the flotilla's actual mornings - the data horizon is 30 Sep 23:00 and the first leg is 4 Oct. For the current period, the rehearsal run points to 06:00 departures across the board, with Portorosa-Lipari deteriorating after 11:00 on 25 Sep as the afternoon sea breeze fills. Expect the first genuinely useful departure-window guidance around 30 Sep - 1 Oct, when the trip dates come inside the 5-7 day range.

cautions: Nothing in the current data is threatening - winds stay under about 10 kt and seas under 1.7 ft. Do not read that across to the trip dates.

ECMWF IFS gusts are interval maxima, not instantaneous values, so they look extreme in light air: 42.4 kt at Lipari and 37.1 kt at Salina around midday 25 Sep against 8-9 kt means. Treat as model artefact, but it does hint at an unstable, gusty afternoon breeze pattern.

Models disagree at Lipari 18:00 on 25 Sep: 0.7 to 7.8 kt. Direction, not strength, is the weak point right now - forecast stability shows mean direction shifts of 44-66 deg at every lead time, which matters for anchorage choice more than for passage-making.

Stromboli's Marina del Gabbiano scores only 'workable' in the rehearsal - open from every direction, so shelter there depends entirely on the calm holding. Worth noting now for planning the optional Stromboli night.
ICON-2i runs only ~60-72 h ahead and will not cover the trip at all until roughly 1-2 Oct; MFWAM is currently 22.5 h old.
briefing.confidence_note: Confidence in the near-term light-air pattern is reasonable - the three wind models agree within a few knots and stability checks show mean wind shifts of only 0.6-1.4 kt out to 120 h - but the departure date is nine days away, entirely beyond the 30 Sep data horizon, so there is no forecast basis for the trip itself.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
